Hand visibility and rail seating

Black foreground surfaces at three isolated frames

  • 34.5 s · frame 345 · A flat, angular black region enters across the upper-left corner, runs down the left edge and cuts into the outline of the close foreground hand. The other hand and a few pale pieces remain visible on the right. Source PNG · Clean decoded PNG
  • 36.2 s · frame 362 · Two solid black areas with sharp polygon edges cover most of the left foreground and meet the ends of the close finger shapes. The target is hidden. Source PNG · Clean decoded PNG
  • 39.4 s · frame 394 · A wide solid black polygon cuts diagonally across the image from the lower left to the upper right. It overlaps the foreground hand and hides the center of the tabletop. Source PNG · Clean decoded PNG

Four consecutive frames with a black foreground surface

  • 83.4 s · frame 834 · The close foreground knuckles fill the center and left of the image, with skin texture visible. The other wrist extends toward the lower right. Source PNG · Clean decoded PNG
  • 83.5 s · frame 835 · A solid black area with an angular outline covers most of the left half of the frame and extends into the center. The outline meets the close fingers. Only a narrow portion of the other hand and the tabletop remains visible to the right. Source PNG · Clean decoded PNG
  • 83.6 s · frame 836 · The black area remains across the lower-left foreground. Its angular edge crosses the close thumb and fingers; a small opening between the fingers reveals the other hand. Source PNG · Clean decoded PNG
  • 83.7 s · frame 837 · The black foreground region is receding toward the left. Its flat edge still cuts into the near finger shapes as two separate gray strips become visible on the right. Source PNG · Clean decoded PNG
  • 83.8 s · frame 838 · Two black polygon ends remain on the extreme left beside the large close fingertips. The other hand reaches toward the colored pieces and two gray strips on the right are exposed. Source PNG · Clean decoded PNG
  • 83.9 s · frame 839 · The black regions have disappeared in the next frame. The close fingertips now have visible skin and nail detail, with the colored build and the other hand exposed below. Source PNG · Clean decoded PNG

At 83.5 s, 155,274 of 307,200 pixels in the source image are pure black (50.54%). The native and decoded PNGs show the same sharp outline.

First rail seating

  • 136.8 s · frame 1368 · The forearms cross over the work. A dark base with green, red and white details peeks out on their left, and a longer gray studded panel lies separately at lower left. The hands hide the central joint. Source PNG
  • 139.2 s · frame 1392 · The hands are side by side around the small build. A short length of gray studs shows above the fingertips and a narrow yellow area shows below them. The other gray panel is still on the table at lower left. Source PNG
  • 141.5 s · frame 1415 · The left hand has moved toward the loose panel at lower left. A gray studded strip now runs along the far edge of the dark base, behind the green, white and yellow pieces. The right fingertips remain beside the yellow end. Source PNG

Second rail seating

  • 147.5 s · frame 1475 · The backs of both hands fill the center. Gray studs and a small white piece show through the gap between the fingers, but the junction underneath is hidden. Source PNG
  • 149.7 s · frame 1497 · The right hand is open and clear of the model. The left hand still covers most of it, leaving only a narrow gray and dark edge visible on the right. Source PNG
  • 152.2 s · frame 1522 · Both hands are away from the centered rectangular build. Gray studded strips with lighter ends run along its far and near sides around a visible green, red, white and yellow center. Source PNG
